services.name: SceneTransition_RenderSelectionCursor
services.behavior: Runs the shared scene-resource command interpreter for the transition selection cursor stream.

services.name: Scene_EnterTransitionMode
services.selection_state: Initializes and adjusts SCENE_TRANSITION_SELECTION_INDEX within the range 0..3 while processing controller input.

stream.observed_content: Cursor arrow and surrounding blank rows encoded as scene-resource command/text records.

conclusion: The former anonymous helper is the transition-mode cursor renderer. The selection index and stream address are now explicit, while the user-facing labels represented by the surrounding rows remain unresolved.
